subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` preserve readable non-regular sources accepted by the shipped `fs.readFile` path, or intentionally become restricted to regular files and symlinks resolving to regular files?
rationale: Bounding memory is clearly desirable, but choosing whether to preserve FIFO/device compatibility or narrow the public CLI contract is a product and upgrade decision that source, docs, and discussion do not resolve.

options.title: Preserve readable sources
options.body: Use a bounded streaming reader that retains previously readable source types while stopping and rejecting input after 4 MiB.

options.title: Restrict to regular files
options.body: Keep the narrower contract only with explicit maintainer approval, public documentation, and upgrade-oriented rejection coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve readable sources
recommendation.body: Use a bounded streaming reader that retains previously readable source types while stopping and rejecting input after 4 MiB.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original public CLI feature and are the strongest available history-backed owner for its compatibility decision.
